Title: Azure Cost Management features in development—October 2019

Body.Content:
New Azure Cost Management features are currently in development and should be available in the next few months. See this table for details:

Azure Cost Management features in development

Feature Area

Feature

Showback

Allocate costs across different subscriptions
 

Apply custom cost markups

Budgets

Alerts based on forecasted cost for a given period

Customer channel support

Azure Cost Management for partners supporting Microsoft Customer Agreements
 

Partner-enabled Azure Cost Management for customers with Azure plans under the Microsoft Customer Agreement
 

Azure Cost Management for CSP customers
